teaminternational.com: 64. The gap: broken links.

Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 16 internal links lead to an error.

Lesson: Check your own links after each release, and fix or redirect every one that answers 404.

One automated analysis of public pages on 19 Oct 2026, requested through QA-lab URL Review. A starting point, not a verdict.

epssura.com: 40. The gap: form labels.

Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 161 form controls have no label.

Lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.

One automated analysis of public pages on 20 Oct 2026, requested through QA-lab URL Review. A starting point, not a verdict.
